summary: A text-only hint attached to a trigger. Opens on hover and on focus.
useWhen: adding a short clarification that is genuinely optional to read

useInstead.when: the content has anything focusable in it — a link, a button, a field
useInstead.why: a tooltip cannot be focused, cannot be scrolled, and closes the moment the pointer leaves

useInstead.when: the information is required to complete the field
useInstead.why: Input's helper text is always visible; a tooltip is not discoverable on touch

top.use: above the trigger — the default reading position

bottom.use: below the trigger, for something near the top of the viewport

left.use: to the left of the trigger

right.use: to the right of the trigger

children.note: the trigger. Must forward both a ref and DOM props

guarantees: focus opens it, not only hover — a hover-only tooltip is invisible to keyboard and switch users
one tooltip open at a time with a shared warmup, so moving along a row of icon buttons does not flash one per button
`placement` flips to the opposite side when there is no room
requires: a trigger that is already labelled for icon-only controls — Tooltip supplies the hint, not the trigger's name

antiPatterns.dont: putting a link or button inside `label`
antiPatterns.why: it cannot be reached — the tooltip closes when the pointer leaves the trigger

antiPatterns.dont: a tooltip as the only place information appears
antiPatterns.why: it is undiscoverable on touch, where there is no hover

antiPatterns.dont: a tooltip on a disabled Button
antiPatterns.why: a disabled button takes no focus and often no pointer events, so the hint never appears for a keyboard user
